Name: Necho, King of Egypt
Summary: Necho, king of Egypt, came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates; he warned Josiah that God had commanded him to make haste and not to meddle, but Josiah disguised himself, fought at Megiddo, was wounded by archers, and died at Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Necho sent ambassadors saying, 'What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me,' but Josiah hearkened not.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoahaz, Son of Josiah
LifeLesson: Ignoring a warning, even from an enemy king, can end a righteous reign.
